At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better worldDiscover your exciting roleWe are currently looking for a Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) for our Headquarters in Stuttgart / Germany.The Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) is responsible for supporting the Vice President Compensation & Benefits and Mobility in designing, managing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving compensation and benefits programs to align across Exyte's global organization with the Global strategy. The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.Explore your tasks and responsibilities- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.Show your expertise- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.- Strong knowledge of global governance and the ability to translate enterprise principles into practical, locally compliant solutions.- Experience working across multiple countries and regions within a complex, matrixed multinational organization.- Advanced analytical, financial-modeling, and data-visualization capability, including expert-level Excel skills and experience with HRIS and reporting tools.- Demonstrated ability to influence executives and align diverse global and regional stakeholders without direct authority.- Strong project, change, and vendor-management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent global initiatives.- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and cross-cultural communication skills; professional fluency in English.- Fluent in German with a strong knowledge of German laws essential.What we offer you- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues- Attractive location: Our location features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in GermanyContact:You want to be part of the Exyte team? I handle the complete relocation and visa process for you, including all the paperwork. Your Benefits - Secure, permanent employment directly with a German company - Competitive German salary - Complete support with your German visa and relocation process - Assistance with finding accommodation - One personal contact from start to finish - me Why contact me? If your profile fits a position, I’ll tell you.If it doesn’t, I’ll tell you that too.  Ready for your next step in Germany?     Send me a Mail or WhatsApp message. jobs.description: Über diesen Job:CHECK24 is the comparison portal: We are both the market leader and a dynamic startup. Working in agile teams, we make fast decisions and embrace flat hierarchies. By leveraging the latest tools and technologies as well as state-of-the-art AI methods, we drive data-driven innovation – always focusing on creating added value for our customers. Across more than 50 products, we work every day to continuously improve the user experience of our more than 20 million customers.Our Search Team within CHECK24 AI Forge develops scalable AI solutions for search and ranking across different CHECK24 products. Search is a crucial entry and navigation point for our customers and covers challenging domains ranging from e-commerce product search and web-style navigation to travel search for hotels, destinations and other products.Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.Was Du mitbringst:- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not requiredZu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impactWas wir Dir bieten:Development and responsibility- Your commitment pays off – we support your talent and provide opportunities to grow your career quickly- Take ownership of your topics, contribute your own ideas, try new approaches and gradually assume responsibility for production Search and Ranking systems- Benefit from internal training with specialized coaches as well as an annual budget for external professional developmentTeam spirit and modern workspace- Experience team spirit in your daily work and beyond, whether over lunch, a game of table football or after-work activities, and balance- Fridays are home-office optional – and spending them in the office can earn you additional vacation days on top of your 28 days- Get to the office conveniently with your free
